-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.Restart` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.bootPremiseR_persistent (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id
    : w64) : Persistent (etcdstart.bootPremiseR N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id)

def etcdstart.memberBuiltR (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (id : w64) (N : Nat) (served : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γA ci TM E γrn b cfg γk τ at₀ A,
      ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
            E.authOn = false ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗
        srvServeStock s E ∗
          srvWatchBuilt s E ∗
            srvBuiltR s γA ci TM E ρ ρ.rd
                (srvErM false ρ E₀ (W64 0) (W64 0) (restartKV ρ.rd.kv A) id (srvTrKey γn γk) (srvTrStopK γk)) γrn b
                (W64 0) at₀ (W64 0) (restartKV ρ.rd.kv A) N ∗
              srvServeBuilt s E cfg ∗
                srvSVRes s E ∗
                  srvMonitorsOff s ∗
                    srvLgReader s ∗
                      srvReadyCloser s ∗
                        srvNetMember γn s id τ ∗
                          srvTrTok γn τ ∗
                            etcdstart.memberPeerServeRes γn τ served ∗
                              etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E lease.Mode.none ∗ srvStop.keep s cfg E γrn γk)

def etcdstart.memberRestartFacts (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ρ.rd.raft = { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
          ρ.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧
            ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false ∧
              ρ.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧
                ρ.ids.pfx = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∧ ρ.rd.kv.cmp = false ∧ lease.runCfg ρ.rd.kv.lm lease.Mode.none⌝ ∗
      srvRaftLogInv ρ.rd.raft ∗
        idClusterInv ρ.ids.issued ρ.ids.cnt ρ.ids.wn ρ.ids.fs srvFloorFacts ∗
          idNoZero ρ.ids ∗ srvPropMint ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids ∗ srvRdCtxInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids.issued ∗ kvInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.rd.kv)

theorem etcdstart.memberBoot_restartFacts [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id :
    w64) : etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id ⊢ etcdstart.memberRestartFacts γ ρ id ∗
    etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id

def etcdstart.bootPremiseR (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ cfg U γ,
        ⌜etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg ∧ Uok U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
          bootstrapRestartContract cfg U γ id N dir)

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartFacts_persistent (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.memberRestartFacts γ ρ id)
